__comments.suffix_reoptimization_v2_0: Enable the complete suffix v2.0 sidecar selected by suffix_version.
__comments.suffix_v2_0_layer_offsets: Use target layer L and only following layers L+1/L+2; out-of-range layers are removed.
__comments.suffix_v2_0_layer_weights: Raw layer weights; effective in-range weights are normalized before use.
__comments.suffix_v2_0_phase1: Direction-dominant joint-error optimization with per-step SGD and frozen prefix/padding.
__comments.suffix_v2_0_phase2: Magnitude-dominant joint-error optimization with persistent Adam, Phase-1 proximity, and range constraints.
__comments.suffix_v2_0_candidate_pools: Stage 4 uses embedding 10/20 plus PPL 10 plus the pre-selection current token; repair uses embedding 20 plus PPL 10 and its explicit current-token baseline.
__comments.suffix_v2_0_cumulative: CUSUM kappa/threshold are initial heuristic values that still require experimental calibration.
__comments.suffix_v2_0_classifier_enabled: Keep the provider interface but do not require or call it while false. When true, provider absence or invalid results are fatal.
